title: Young Adult Food Messaging Experiment
official: An Experiment Evaluating the Effectiveness of Counter-marketing Food Messages Among Young Adults
summary: The primary objective of this study is to identify the food counter-marketing messages (i.e., messages that describe deceptive marketing tactics used by food companies) that are perceived as most effective among young adults.

interventions.name: Lying about unhealthy foods being healthy
Covering up the evidence about the harms of unhealthy foods

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age between 18-29 years
* Reside in the United States
* Consume at least 5-6 servings per week of sugary drinks and 5-6 servings per week of sweet and salty snacks

Exclusion Criteria:

* Younger than 18 or older than 29 years
* Reside outside of the United States
* Consume less than 5-6 servings per week of sugary drinks or less than 5-6 servings per week of sweet and salty snacks
